rationale: The description explicitly states that the service desk software is powered by machine learning, supporting the AI-positive binary.
ai_type_rationale: The text describes a conventional service desk and ITSM platform as well as machine learning, supporting an enabled interpretation, but it does not establish whether the core service-desk functions depend on machine learning. The subtype is therefore weak and forced.
evidence_spans: Service Manager is scalable service desk software powered by machine learning, analytics, and automation
ai_type_evidence_spans: standardizing service delivery and support across the enterprise
conflict_response: The proposals agree that the machine-learning statement supports ai_status=ai. They differ on subtype strength: the blind proposal treated the conventional service-desk core as sufficient for supported ai_enabled, while the labeler noted that dependence of the core on machine learning is not established. Retain ai_enabled as the best subtype, but mark it weak and forced rather than treating the subtype agreement as proof.
